name: knot_memory_recall
description: Recall cognitive memories from the Knot Swarm Memory Palace using vector cosine similarity, keyword search, spatial filtering, tags, and memory pool.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default: 5).

pool.description: Optional memory pool filter: 'shared' (swarm-promoted), 'local' (this node's scratchpad), or 'all'.

query.description: Keyword or semantic search string across memory titles and contents using in-process vector cosine similarity.

tags.description: Optional list of tags to filter by.
